items.prompt:
Repeating a phrase at the start of successive sentences is:
A) anaphora (repetition)
B) a statistic
C) a definition

The reason an author writes a text is their:
A) purpose
B) page count
C) font

'How something is said' is a text's:
A) style
B) page number
C) margin

A speech repeats 'I have a dream' to begin successive sentences. This style contributes to the text's power by:
A) building rhythm and growing emotional force
B) hiding the point
C) adding statistics
items.answer: A) building rhythm and growing emotional force

solution.answer: A) building rhythm and growing emotional force

items.prompt:
A persuasive essay pairs vivid imagery with hard statistics. Together, style and content:
A) make it both moving and convincing
B) cancel out
C) have no effect
items.answer: A) make it both moving and convincing

steps: Style moves, content convinces. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) make it both moving and convincing

items.prompt:
Why does HOW something is said matter in powerful rhetoric?
A) style shapes the message's power, persuasiveness, and beauty
B) only the facts matter
C) it never matters
items.answer: A) style shapes the message's power, persuasiveness, and beauty

steps: Style shapes impact. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) style shapes the message's power, persuasiveness, and beauty

items.prompt:
A speech ends, 'We shall not falter; we shall not fail; we shall prevail.' The style contributes to its power mainly through:
A) parallelism and rising repetition that build momentum
B) a dry statistic
C) a change of topic
items.answer: A) parallelism and rising repetition that build momentum

steps: Parallel + repetition = power. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) parallelism and rising repetition that build momentum

items.prompt:
To analyze an author's EFFECTIVE rhetoric, you examine how:
A) style and content together create the text's power, persuasiveness, or beauty
B) long the text is
C) old the author is
items.answer: A) style and content together create the text's power, persuasiveness, or beauty

steps: Style + content = effect. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) style and content together create the text's power, persuasiveness, or beauty
